'''El Clásico''' ({{IPA|es|el ˈklasiko}}; {{langx|ca|El Clàssic}}, {{IPA|ca|əl ˈklasik|pron}}; {{lang|en|"The Classic"}}), is the name given to the [[basketball]] matches between [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] and [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] (named after the cities they are based in; both cities are separated by 621&nbsp;km), the two most successful and most supported basketball teams in Spain. Just as their [[El Clásico|football rivalry]], basketball ''Clásico'' is known for its intensity and adversarial nature.

The first match was played on 18 March 1942, at the Frontón Recoletos in [[Madrid]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Baloncesto. Hoy a las diez y media de la noche, en el frontón Recoletos |url=https://hemerotecadigital.bne.es/hd/es/viewer?id=bf0efc59-6e46-48b7-bab5-905c45dbedd1&page=4 |website=Hemeroteca Digital. Biblioteca Nacional de España |publisher=Gol (Madrid) |access-date=12 April 2025 |location=Madrid |page=4 |language=es |date=18 March 1942}}</ref> It was an [[exhibition game]] and is notable for having been played around midnight, with the tip-off scheduled at 23:45 p.m.<ref>{{cite web |title=1942: El primer Madrid-Barcelona se jugó a medianoche |url=https://www.feb.es/2023/5/10/baloncesto/1942-primer-madrid-barcelona-jugo-medianoche/93794.aspx |publisher=Federación Española de Baloncesto (FEB) |access-date=11 April 2025 |language=es |date=10 May 2023}}</ref> Real Madrid defeated Barcelona 25-12.<ref>{{cite web |title=Baloncesto. El Madrid derrota ampliamente al Barcelona por 25-12 |url=https://hemerotecadigital.bne.es/hd/es/viewer?id=b252a7e9-c6cc-46d5-aba0-59e7e58a0aef |website=Hemeroteca Digital. Biblioteca Nacional de España |publisher=Gol (Madrid) |access-date=12 April 2025 |location=Madrid |page=1 |language=es |date=19 March 1942}}</ref>
